summary: Update protobuf dependency constraint to support v5 alongside v4. The API DTOs package already supports protobuf v5.
userImpact: Allows users to opt-in to protobuf v5 while maintaining compatibility with v4.
proposedFix: Update version constraint to `^4.31.1 || ^5.34.0` in composer.json
resolutionDetails: Updated protobuf dependency constraint in composer.json to support both v4 and v5
